description: Resolved a CIP Sync/PTP grandmaster conflict impacting the motion layer, restoring deterministic plant‑wide timing in ~6 hours and mitigating ~$3,500/hr downtime exposure. Implemented PLC change tracking, automated backups and OPC restoration across undocumented servers to avoid $40,000–$80,000 in external recovery costs. Delivered a GuardLink safety upgrade using existing infrastructure, avoiding ~$170,000 capital versus a $200,000 proposal. Standardized virtualized Rockwell toolchains and reproducible engineering baselines, saving ~$1,400 per workstation. Partnered with IT to segment access, automate backups and integrate domain logins; stabilized legacy industrial Ethernet (VLANs, IGMP, CIP/IEEE‑1588) and led OT escalation for network and automation incidents.
highlights: Restored plant‑wide deterministic PTP timing (~$3.5K/hr downtime mitigated)
